title: [Fabric] Clean up test events, app naming, authentication and telemetry
summary: The Fabric mirroring app makes five test-only IsHandled events in Fabric Platform Mgt internal, renames the app to Business Central Mirroring to Fabric (preview), removes the unused Key Vault first-party client-ID lookup, and replaces pseudo-audit telemetry events with real audit logs via Audit Log.LogAuditMessage.
key_points: Five test-only IsHandled events in Fabric Platform Mgt are now internal; the test app keeps access via internalsVisibleTo
App and test app renamed to Business Central Mirroring to Fabric (preview) and Business Central Mirroring to Fabric Tests, with dependency and build metadata updated
Removed the unused Key Vault first-party client-ID lookup; custom-app auth reads GetCustomClientId() directly
Eight pseudo-audit telemetry events replaced with Audit Log.LogAuditMessage using ApplicationManagement category; GetAuditDimensions() removed
Diagnostic event IDs kept at direct Session.LogMessage calls
